description: This file provides syntax helper utilities for analyzing C# code using Roslyn, specifically for attributes, member declarations, inheritance, and type analysis within the Orleans.Analyzers namespace.

classes.name: AttributeArgumentBag<T>
classes.description: A record struct to hold an attribute argument value along with its source location.

classes.name: SyntaxHelpers
classes.description: A static class containing extension methods for analyzing C# syntax trees using Roslyn.

methods.name: TryGetTypeName
methods.description: Attempts to determine the type name from an AttributeSyntax node.

methods.name: IsAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an AttributeSyntax represents a specific attribute type.

methods.name: HasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a member declaration has a specific attribute.

methods.name: TryGetAttribute
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a specific attribute from a member declaration.

methods.name: GetMemberNameOrDefault
methods.description: Returns the name of a property or field member, or null if not applicable.

methods.name: IsAbstract
methods.description: Checks if a member declaration has the 'abstract' modifier.

methods.name: IsStatic
methods.description: Checks if a member declaration has the 'static' modifier.

methods.name: HasModifier
methods.description: Checks if a member declaration has a specific modifier.

methods.name: IsInstanceMember
methods.description: Determines if a member is an instance member (not static or const).

methods.name: IsFieldOrAutoProperty
methods.description: Checks if a member is a field or an auto-implemented property without a body.

methods.name: ExtendsGrainInterface
methods.description: Determines if an interface extends the Orleans grain interface.

methods.name: InheritsGrainClass
methods.description: Checks if a class inherits from the Orleans grain base class.

methods.name: GetArgumentBag
methods.description: Retrieves the argument value and location from an attribute.

methods.name: GetAttributeSyntaxes
methods.description: Fetches attribute syntax nodes matching a specific name.

methods.name: GetArgumentValue
methods.description: Gets the value of the first argument of an attribute as a string.
